segments.tr: *هذه المقالة لغرض المعلومات العامة ولا تشكل مشورة مالية أو قانونية أو استثمارية.

segments.src: Election results and policy details may change; consult official sources such as the Clerk of the House, the Senate and the Federal Election Commission for confirmed information.*
segments.tr: قد تتغير نتائج الانتخابات وتفاصيل السياسات؛ راجع المصادر الرسمية مثل أمين مجلس النواب ومجلس الشيوخ ولجنة الانتخابات الفيدرالية للحصول على معلومات مؤكدة.*

fr.title: Plus divisés ? Ce qu'une vague de mi-mandat démocrate pourrait signifier pour les prix, les tarifs douaniers et le budget

segments.src: Early reports indicate that Democrats have won control of both the House and the Senate in the 2026 midterm elections, with frustration over the cost of living cited as a central theme among voters.
segments.tr: Des rapports préliminaires indiquent que les démocrates ont remporté le contrôle de la Chambre des représentants et du Sénat lors des élections de mi-mandat de 2026, la frustration liée au coût de la vie étant citée comme un thème central parmi les électeurs.

segments.src: Final tallies and certification can take weeks, so treat any single count with caution.
segments.tr: Les décomptes finaux et la certification peuvent prendre des semaines, il faut donc traiter chaque décompte individuel avec prudence.

segments.src: The more useful question for most households is this: **if control of Congress changes hands, what can lawmakers actually do, and what stays out of their reach?**
segments.tr: La question la plus utile pour la plupart des foyers est la suivante : **si le contrôle du Congrès change de mains, que peuvent réellement faire les législateurs, et qu'est-ce qui reste hors de leur portée ?**

segments.src: This explainer walks through the constitutional tools a new Congress has, the limits it faces, and what to watch between now and the 2028 election.
segments.tr: Cette note explicative passe en revue les outils constitutionnels dont dispose un nouveau Congrès, les limites auxquelles il fait face, et ce qu'il faut surveiller d'ici l'élection de 2028.

segments.src: It is a look at how the system works, not an endorsement of any party or policy.
segments.tr: Il s'agit d'un examen du fonctionnement du système, et non d'un soutien à un parti ou à une politique.

segments.src: ## The timeline: nothing changes overnight
segments.tr: ## Le calendrier : rien ne change du jour au lendemain

segments.src: A newly elected Congress is sworn in on January 3, 2027.
segments.tr: Un Congrès nouvellement élu prête serment le 3 janvier 2027.

segments.src: Until then, the current Congress remains in office, including during any "lame-duck" session in December.
segments.tr: D'ici là, le Congrès actuel reste en fonction, y compris lors de toute session "canard boiteux" en décembre.

segments.src: Even after the handoff, the president keeps the executive branch, the veto pen and most day-to-day regulatory decisions.
segments.tr: Même après la transition, le président conserve le pouvoir exécutif, le droit de véto et la plupart des décisions réglementaires quotidiennes.

segments.src: That means voter anger over prices does not translate into an immediate policy shift.
segments.tr: Cela signifie que la colère des électeurs face aux prix ne se traduit pas par un changement de politique immédiat.

segments.src: Congress sets the rules and the money.
segments.tr: Le Congrès fixe les règles et l'argent.

segments.src: The White House carries them out.
segments.tr: La Maison-Blanche les met en œuvre.

segments.src: ## Prices: Congress has indirect levers, not a price dial
segments.tr: ## Prix : le Congrès dispose de leviers indirects, et non d'un bouton de réglage des prix

segments.src: No branch of government can directly set the price of groceries, rent or gasoline.
segments.tr: Aucune branche du gouvernement ne peut fixer directement le prix de l'épicerie, du loyer ou de l'essence.

segments.src: Inflation and affordability are shaped by interest rates (set by the independent Federal Reserve), supply chains, energy markets, wages, housing supply and trade policy.
segments.tr: L'inflation et l'accessibilité financière sont façonnées par les taux d'intérêt (fixés par la Réserve fédérale, qui est indépendante), les chaînes d'approvisionnement, les marchés de l'énergie, les salaires, l'offre de logements et la politique commerciale.

segments.src: What Congress can influence:
segments.tr: Ce que le Congrès peut influencer :

segments.src: - **Taxes and credits.** Changes to tax law can alter what families keep, but most major tax legislation needs 60 votes in the Senate unless it moves through the budget reconciliation process.
segments.tr: - **Impôts et crédits.** Les modifications de la législation fiscale peuvent modifier ce que les familles conservent, mais la plupart des grandes lois fiscales nécessitent 60 voix au Sénat à moins de passer par le processus de conciliation budgétaire.

segments.src: - **Spending programs.** Funding for housing, food assistance, health subsidies and energy programs is set in law.
segments.tr: - **Programmes de dépenses.** Le financement du logement, de l'aide alimentaire, des subventions de santé et des programmes énergétiques est fixé par la loi.

segments.src: - **Trade rules.** Tariffs are taxes on imports, and the Constitution gives Congress the power to levy them (more below).
segments.tr: - **Règles commerciales.** Les droits de douane sont des taxes sur les importations, et la Constitution donne au Congrès le pouvoir de les lever (plus de détails ci-dessous).

segments.src: - **Regulatory pressure.** Hearings, funding limits and statutory changes can push agencies in a different direction.
segments.tr: - **Pression réglementaire.** Les audiences, les limites de financement et les modifications statutaires peuvent orienter les agences dans une direction différente.

segments.src: What it cannot do quickly: lower mortgage rates, reverse global commodity swings or override the Fed.
segments.tr: Ce qu'il ne peut pas faire rapidement : baisser les taux hypothécaires, inverser les fluctuations mondiales des matières premières ou passer outre la Fed.

segments.src: Economists generally caution that policy changes take months or years to show up in household budgets.
segments.tr: Les économistes préviennent généralement que les changements politiques prennent des mois ou des années à se refléter dans les budgets des ménages.

segments.src: ## Tariffs: Congress holds the power on paper, but the veto looms
segments.tr: ## Droits de douane : le Congrès détient le pouvoir sur papier, mais le véto plane

segments.src: Under the Constitution, the power to impose tariffs belongs to Congress.
segments.tr: En vertu de la Constitution, le pouvoir d'imposer des droits de douane appartient au Congrès.

segments.src: Over decades, lawmakers have delegated broad authority to the president through laws such as Section 232 (national security), Section 301 (unfair trade practices) and emergency statutes.
segments.tr: Au fil des décennies, les législateurs ont délégué de vastes pouvoirs au président par le biais de lois telles que la Section 232 (sécurité nationale), la Section 301 (pratiques commerciales déloyales) et des lois d'urgence.

segments.src: Much of recent tariff policy has relied on those delegations, and some of them have been challenged in court.
segments.tr: Une grande partie de la politique tarifaire récente s'est appuyée sur ces délégations, et certaines d'entre elles ont été contestées en justice.

segments.src: A Democratic-controlled Congress could try to:
segments.tr: Un Congrès contrôlé par les démocrates pourrait essayer de :

segments.src: 1. **Pass legislation** narrowing or ending specific tariff authorities.
segments.tr: 1. **Adopter une législation** réduisant ou mettant fin à des pouvoirs tarifaires spécifiques.

segments.src: 2. **Use disapproval resolutions**, where the law provides for them, to terminate emergency declarations that underpin certain tariffs.
segments.tr: 2. **Utiliser des résolutions de désapprobation**, là où la loi le prévoit, pour mettre fin aux déclarations d'urgence qui soutiennent certains droits de douane.

segments.src: 3. **Hold hearings** that require officials to explain costs, exemptions and effects on consumers and businesses.
segments.tr: 3. **Tenir des audiences** qui obligent les fonctionnaires à expliquer les coûts, les exemptions et les effets sur les consommateurs et les entreprises.

segments.src: 4. **Attach conditions** to must-pass legislation.
segments.tr: 4. **Assortir de conditions** la législation incontournable.

segments.src: The obstacle is arithmetic.
segments.tr: L'obstacle est mathématique.

segments.src: A president can veto a bill, and overriding a veto requires two-thirds of both chambers.
segments.tr: Un président peut opposer son véto à un projet de loi, et pour passer outre, il faut les deux tiers des voix dans les deux chambres.

segments.src: Unless a meaningful number of Republicans join, a veto would likely stand.
segments.tr: À moins qu'un nombre significatif de républicains ne se joignent à eux, un véto tiendrait probablement.

segments.src: Tariff skepticism has existed in both parties and among many business groups, so cross-party coalitions are possible, but they are not guaranteed.
segments.tr: Le scepticisme à l'égard des droits de douane a existé dans les deux partis et parmi de nombreux groupes d'entreprises, de sorte que des coalitions transpartisanes sont possibles, mais elles ne sont pas garanties.

segments.src: Courts also matter.
segments.tr: Les tribunaux comptent également.

segments.src: Judicial rulings on how far presidential tariff authority extends can reshape the debate regardless of who controls Congress.
segments.tr: Les décisions judiciaires sur l'étendue du pouvoir présidentiel en matière tarifaire peuvent redéfinir le débat, peu importe qui contrôle le Congrès.

segments.src: ## The budget: where the "power of the purse" becomes real
segments.tr: ## Le budget : là où le "pouvoir de la purse" devient réel

segments.src: Congress's strongest tool is funding.
segments.tr: L'outil le plus puissant du Congrès est le financement.

segments.src: Federal agencies operate on annual appropriations, and the fiscal year begins October 1.
segments.tr: Les agences fédérales fonctionnent sur des crédits annuels, et l'exercice budgétaire commence le 1er octobre.

segments.src: A new majority gains leverage in several ways:
segments.tr: Une nouvelle majorité gagne en influence de plusieurs manières :

segments.src: - **Appropriations bills.** The House originates spending bills, and the Senate must also pass them. A majority in both chambers lets Democrats shape priorities, set funding levels and add policy guardrails.
segments.tr: - **Projets de loi de crédits.** La Chambre à l'origine des projets de loi de dépenses, et le Sénat doit également les adopter. Une majorité dans les deux chambres permet aux démocrates de façonner les priorités, de fixer les niveaux de financement et d'ajouter des garde-fous politiques.

segments.src: - **Shutdown brinkmanship.** If the two branches cannot agree, funding lapses. Shutdowns are costly and politically risky for everyone involved, which is why most fights end in compromise.
segments.tr: - **Crise du budget (brinkmanship).** Si les deux branches ne parviennent pas à s'entendre, le financement expire. Les fermetures de gouvernement (shutdowns) sont coûteuses et politiquement risquées pour toutes les personnes impliquées, c'est pourquoi la plupart des combats se terminent par un compromis.

segments.src: - **Continuing resolutions and deadlines.** Short-term funding extensions often become the real negotiating moments.
segments.tr: - **Résolutions continues et échéances.** Les extensions de financement à court terme deviennent souvent les véritables moments de négociation.

segments.src: - **The debt limit.** Raising or suspending it is required to pay obligations already incurred, and it has repeatedly become a flashpoint.
segments.tr: - **La limite de la dette.** L'augmenter ou la suspendre est nécessaire pour payer les obligations déjà contractées, et elle est devenue à plusieurs reprises un point de friction.

segments.src: The limits: the Senate filibuster still requires 60 votes for most legislation, unless the rules change.
segments.tr: Les limites : l'obstruction systématique (filibuster) au Sénat nécessite toujours 60 voix pour la plupart des lois, à moins que les règles ne changent.

segments.src: Any spending bill still needs the president's signature, so a final budget would be a negotiated outcome, not a one-party wish list.
segments.tr: Tout projet de loi de dépenses a toujours besoin de la signature du président, de sorte qu'un budget final serait le fruit d'une négociation et non d'une liste de souhaits d'un seul parti.

segments.src: The president can also affect how funds are spent through administrative choices, which is a frequent source of disputes.
segments.tr: Le président peut également influer sur la manière dont les fonds sont dépensés par le biais de choix administratifs, ce qui est une source fréquente de litiges.

segments.src: ## Oversight: the quickest change you may notice
segments.tr: ## Contrôle parlementaire (Oversight) : le changement le plus rapide que vous remarquerez

segments.src: The most immediate shift under a new majority is often not legislation but scrutiny.
segments.tr: Le changement le plus immédiat sous une nouvelle majorité n'est souvent pas la législation, mais le contrôle.

segments.src: Committee chairs control agendas, and they can:
segments.tr: Les présidents de commission contrôlent les ordres du jour, et ils peuvent :

segments.src: - Schedule hearings and call witnesses
segments.tr: - Planifier des audiences et convoquer des témoins

segments.src: - Issue subpoenas for documents and testimony
segments.tr: - Émettre des assignations à comparaître pour des documents et des témoignages

segments.src: - Request audits and reports from watchdog agencies
segments.tr: - Demander des audits et des rapports aux agences de surveillance

segments.src: - Investigate agency decisions, contracts and spending
segments.tr: - Enquêter sur les décisions, les contrats et les dépenses des agences

segments.src: If the Senate also changes hands, the effects extend to **confirmations**.
segments.tr: Si le Sénat change également de mains, les effets s'étendent aux **confirmations**.

segments.src: The Senate approves cabinet officials, judges and other senior appointments, so a different majority can slow, reshape or block nominations.
segments.tr: Le Sénat approuve les membres du cabinet, les juges et d'autres nominations de haut rang, de sorte qu'une majorité différente peut ralentir, remodeler ou bloquer les nominations.

segments.src: The House also holds the power to impeach, but conviction requires two-thirds of the Senate, a very high bar.
segments.tr: La Chambre détient également le pouvoir de mise en accusation (impeachment), mais la condamnation nécessite les deux tiers du Sénat, ce qui est un seuil très élevé.

segments.src: Historically, impeachment has been rare and has not resulted in removal.
segments.tr: Historiquement, la mise en accusation a été rare et n'a pas entraîné de destitution.

segments.src: ## Reality check: divided government is still divided
segments.tr: ## Retour à la réalité : un gouvernement divisé reste divisé

segments.src: Even if both chambers flip, Washington would remain a system of shared power.
segments.tr: Même si les deux chambres basculent, Washington resterait un système de pouvoir partagé.

segments.src: A president of the other party retains the veto, executive orders, enforcement discretion and the ability to direct agencies.
segments.tr: Un président de l'autre parti conserve le droit de véto, les décrets exécutifs, le pouvoir discrétionnaire d'application et la capacité de diriger les agences.

segments.src: Expect:
segments.tr: Attendez-vous à :

segments.src: - **Gridlock on major bills**, with compromise limited to must-pass items such as funding.
segments.tr: - **Une impasse sur les grands projets de loi**, les compromis se limitant aux éléments incontournables tels que le financement.

segments.src: - **A heavy calendar of hearings** and investigations.
segments.tr: - **Un calendrier chargé d'audiences** et d'enquêtes.

segments.src: - **Messaging votes** designed to frame choices ahead of 2028.
segments.tr: - **Des votes de signal** conçus pour encadrer les choix avant 2028.

segments.src: - **Court battles** over the boundaries of executive and legislative authority.
segments.tr: - **Des batailles judiciaires** sur les limites de l'autorité exécutive et législative.

segments.src: ## What to watch before 2028
segments.tr: ## Ce qu'il faut surveiller avant 2028

segments.src: - **Certified results and final margins.** Narrow majorities make party discipline and absences matter.
segments.tr: - **Les résultats certifiés et les marges finales.** Des majorités étroites font que la discipline de parti et les absences comptent.

segments.src: - **The next funding deadline.** It is the first big test of how the two branches work together.
segments.tr: - **La prochaine échéance de financement.** C'est le premier grand test sur la façon dont les deux branches travaillent ensemble.

segments.src: - **Tariff developments.** Look for court decisions, trade negotiations and any bipartisan bills.
segments.tr: - **L'évolution des droits de douane.** Recherchez les décisions de justice, les négociations commerciales et tout projet de loi bipartisan.

segments.src: - **Economic data.** Monthly inflation reports, wage growth and Fed decisions will shape the political mood more than any single vote.
segments.tr: - **Les données économiques.** Les rapports mensuels sur l'inflation, la croissance des salaires et les décisions de la Fed façonneront l'ambiance politique plus que tout vote unique.

segments.src: - **Committee leadership.** Who chairs key panels signals which issues get priority.
segments.tr: - **La direction des commissions.** Qui préside les comités clés indique quels dossiers sont prioritaires.

segments.src: ## Bottom line
segments.tr: ## En résumé

segments.src: A change in congressional control can reshape the agenda, the budget fights and the level of scrutiny in Washington.
segments.tr: Un changement de contrôle au Congrès peut remodeler l'agenda, les luttes budgétaires et le niveau de contrôle à Washington.

segments.src: It is much less likely to produce rapid, sweeping changes to prices or trade policy without cooperation from the White House.
segments.tr: Il est beaucoup moins probable qu'il produise des changements rapides et radicaux sur les prix ou la politique commerciale sans la coopération de la Maison-Blanche.

segments.tr: Pour les lecteurs, la leçon pratique est de surveiller ce qui est adopté et promulgué, et pas seulement ce qui est débattu.

pt.title: Divididos Nunca Mais? O que uma Onda Democrática de Meio de Termo Pode Significar para Preços, Tarifas e o Orçamento

segments.src: Early reports indicate that Democrats have won control of both the House and the Senate in the 2026 midterm elections, with frustration over the cost of living cited as a central theme among voters.
segments.tr: Relatórios iniciais indicam que os democratas conquistaram o controle da Câmara e do Senado nas eleições de meio de termo de 2026, tendo a frustração com o custo de vida como tema central entre os eleitores.

segments.src: Final tallies and certification can take weeks, so treat any single count with caution.
segments.tr: A contagem final e a certificação podem levar semanas, portanto, trate qualquer contagem isolada com cautela.

segments.src: The more useful question for most households is this: **if control of Congress changes hands, what can lawmakers actually do, and what stays out of their reach?**
segments.tr: A pergunta mais útil para a maioria das famílias é a seguinte: **se o controle do Congresso mudar de mãos, o que os legisladores podem realmente fazer e o que permanece fora do alcance deles?**

segments.src: This explainer walks through the constitutional tools a new Congress has, the limits it faces, and what to watch between now and the 2028 election.
segments.tr: Este artigo explicativo aborda as ferramentas constitucionais que um novo Congresso possui, os limites que ele enfrenta e o que observar daqui até a eleição de 2028.

segments.src: It is a look at how the system works, not an endorsement of any party or policy.
segments.tr: É uma análise de como o sistema funciona, e não um endosso a qualquer partido ou política.

segments.src: ## The timeline: nothing changes overnight
segments.tr: ## O cronograma: nada muda da noite para o dia

segments.src: A newly elected Congress is sworn in on January 3, 2027.
segments.tr: Um Congresso recém-eleito toma posse em 3 de janeiro de 2027.

segments.src: Until then, the current Congress remains in office, including during any "lame-duck" session in December.
segments.tr: Até lá, o Congresso atual permanece no cargo, inclusive durante qualquer sessão "lame-duck" (pato manco) em dezembro.

segments.src: Even after the handoff, the president keeps the executive branch, the veto pen and most day-to-day regulatory decisions.
segments.tr: Mesmo após a transição, o presidente mantém o poder executivo, o poder de veto e a maioria das decisões regulatórias cotidianas.

segments.src: That means voter anger over prices does not translate into an immediate policy shift.
segments.tr: Isso significa que a raiva dos eleitores em relação aos preços não se traduz em uma mudança imediata de política.

segments.src: Congress sets the rules and the money.
segments.tr: O Congresso define as regras e o dinheiro.

segments.src: The White House carries them out.
segments.tr: A Casa Branca as executa.

segments.src: ## Prices: Congress has indirect levers, not a price dial
segments.tr: ## Preços: o Congresso tem alavancas indiretas, não um botão de controle de preços

segments.src: No branch of government can directly set the price of groceries, rent or gasoline.
segments.tr: Nenhum ramo do governo pode definir diretamente o preço de mantimentos, aluguel ou gasolina.

segments.src: Inflation and affordability are shaped by interest rates (set by the independent Federal Reserve), supply chains, energy markets, wages, housing supply and trade policy.
segments.tr: A inflação e a acessibilidade são moldadas pelas taxas de juros (definidas pelo Federal Reserve, que é independente), cadeias de suprimentos, mercados de energia, salários, oferta de moradia e política comercial.

segments.src: What Congress can influence:
segments.tr: O que o Congresso pode influenciar:

segments.src: - **Taxes and credits.** Changes to tax law can alter what families keep, but most major tax legislation needs 60 votes in the Senate unless it moves through the budget reconciliation process.
segments.tr: - **Impostos e créditos.** Mudanças nas leis tributárias podem alterar o que as famílias retêm, mas a maioria das grandes legislações fiscais precisa de 60 votos no Senado, a menos que tramitem pelo processo de reconciliação orçamentária.

segments.src: - **Spending programs.** Funding for housing, food assistance, health subsidies and energy programs is set in law.
segments.tr: - **Programas de gastos.** O financiamento para moradia, assistência alimentar, subsídios de saúde e programas de energia é definido por lei.

segments.src: - **Trade rules.** Tariffs are taxes on imports, and the Constitution gives Congress the power to levy them (more below).
segments.tr: - **Regras comerciais.** As tarifas são impostos sobre importações, e a Constituição dá ao Congresso o poder de cobrá-las (mais detalhes abaixo).

segments.src: - **Regulatory pressure.** Hearings, funding limits and statutory changes can push agencies in a different direction.
segments.tr: - **Pressão regulatória.** Audiências, limites de financiamento e alterações estatutárias podem empurrar as agências em uma direção diferente.

segments.src: What it cannot do quickly: lower mortgage rates, reverse global commodity swings or override the Fed.
segments.tr: O que ele não pode fazer rapidamente: baixar as taxas de hipoteca, reverter oscilações globais de commodities ou anular o Fed.

segments.src: Economists generally caution that policy changes take months or years to show up in household budgets.
segments.tr: Os economistas geralmente alertam que as mudanças de políticas levam meses ou anos para aparecer nos orçamentos familiares.

segments.src: ## Tariffs: Congress holds the power on paper, but the veto looms
segments.tr: ## Tarifas: o Congresso detém o poder no papel, mas o veto paira no horizonte

segments.src: Under the Constitution, the power to impose tariffs belongs to Congress.
segments.tr: Sob a Constituição, o poder de impor tarifas pertence ao Congresso.

segments.src: Over decades, lawmakers have delegated broad authority to the president through laws such as Section 232 (national security), Section 301 (unfair trade practices) and emergency statutes.
segments.tr: Ao longo de décadas, os legisladores delegaram ampla autoridade ao presidente por meio de leis como a Seção 232 (segurança nacional), a Seção 301 (práticas comerciais desleais) e estatutos de emergência.

segments.src: Much of recent tariff policy has relied on those delegations, and some of them have been challenged in court.
segments.tr: Grande parte da política tarifária recente tem se apoiado nessas delegações, e algumas delas foram contestadas nos tribunais.

segments.src: A Democratic-controlled Congress could try to:
segments.tr: Um Congresso controlado pelos democratas poderia tentar:

segments.src: 1. **Pass legislation** narrowing or ending specific tariff authorities.
segments.tr: 1. **Aprovar legislação** restringindo ou encerrando autoridades tarifárias específicas.

segments.src: 2. **Use disapproval resolutions**, where the law provides for them, to terminate emergency declarations that underpin certain tariffs.
segments.tr: 2. **Usar resoluções de desaprovação**, onde a lei permitir, para encerrar declarações de emergência que sustentam certas tarifas.

segments.src: 3. **Hold hearings** that require officials to explain costs, exemptions and effects on consumers and businesses.
segments.tr: 3. **Realizar audiências** que exijam que autoridades expliquem custos, isenções e efeitos sobre consumidores e empresas.

segments.src: 4. **Attach conditions** to must-pass legislation.
segments.tr: 4. **Vincular condições** a legislações de aprovação obrigatória.

segments.src: The obstacle is arithmetic.
segments.tr: O obstáculo é a aritmética.

segments.src: A president can veto a bill, and overriding a veto requires two-thirds of both chambers.
segments.tr: Um presidente pode vetar um projeto de lei, e derrubar um veto exige dois terços de ambas as casas.

segments.src: Unless a meaningful number of Republicans join, a veto would likely stand.
segments.tr: A menos que um número significativo de republicanos se junte, um veto provavelmente se sustentará.

segments.src: Tariff skepticism has existed in both parties and among many business groups, so cross-party coalitions are possible, but they are not guaranteed.
segments.tr: O ceticismo em relação às tarifas tem existido em ambos os partidos e entre muitos grupos empresariais, portanto, coalizões multipartidárias são possíveis, mas não garantidas.

segments.src: Courts also matter.
segments.tr: Os tribunais também importam.

segments.src: Judicial rulings on how far presidential tariff authority extends can reshape the debate regardless of who controls Congress.
segments.tr: As decisões judiciais sobre até onde vai a autoridade tarifária presidencial podem remodelar o debate, independentemente de quem controle o Congresso.

segments.src: ## The budget: where the "power of the purse" becomes real
segments.tr: ## O orçamento: onde o "poder da bolsa" se torna real

segments.src: Congress's strongest tool is funding.
segments.tr: A ferramenta mais forte do Congresso é o financiamento.

segments.src: Federal agencies operate on annual appropriations, and the fiscal year begins October 1.
segments.tr: As agências federais operam com dotações anuais, e o ano fiscal começa em 1 de outubro.

segments.src: A new majority gains leverage in several ways:
segments.tr: Uma nova maioria ganha poder de barganha de várias maneiras:

segments.src: - **Appropriations bills.** The House originates spending bills, and the Senate must also pass them. A majority in both chambers lets Democrats shape priorities, set funding levels and add policy guardrails.
segments.tr: - **Projetos de dotações orçamentárias.** A Câmara origina os projetos de gastos, e o Senado também deve aprová-los. A maioria em ambas as casas permite que os democratas moldem prioridades, definam níveis de financiamento e adicionem salvaguardas políticas.

segments.src: - **Shutdown brinkmanship.** If the two branches cannot agree, funding lapses. Shutdowns are costly and politically risky for everyone involved, which is why most fights end in compromise.
segments.tr: - **Impasse e paralisação (shutdown).** Se os dois ramos não conseguirem entrar em acordo, o financiamento cessa. As paralisações são custosas e politicamente arriscadas para todos os envolvidos, razão pela qual a maioria das brigas termina em compromisso.

segments.src: - **Continuing resolutions and deadlines.** Short-term funding extensions often become the real negotiating moments.
segments.tr: - **Resoluções contínuas e prazos.** Extensões de financiamento de curto prazo frequentemente se tornam os verdadeiros momentos de negociação.

segments.src: - **The debt limit.** Raising or suspending it is required to pay obligations already incurred, and it has repeatedly become a flashpoint.
segments.tr: - **O limite da dívida.** Elevar ou suspendê-lo é necessário para pagar obrigações já contraídas, e isso tem se tornado repetidamente um ponto de atrito.

segments.src: The limits: the Senate filibuster still requires 60 votes for most legislation, unless the rules change.
segments.tr: Os limites: a obstrução (filibuster) no Senado ainda exige 60 votos para a maioria da legislação, a menos que as regras mudem.

segments.src: Any spending bill still needs the president's signature, so a final budget would be a negotiated outcome, not a one-party wish list.
segments.tr: Qualquer projeto de lei de gastos ainda precisa da assinatura do presidente, de modo que um orçamento final será um resultado negociado, e não a lista de desejos de um único partido.

segments.src: The president can also affect how funds are spent through administrative choices, which is a frequent source of disputes.
segments.tr: O presidente também pode afetar a forma como os fundos são gastos por meio de escolhas administrativas, o que é uma fonte frequente de disputas.

segments.src: ## Oversight: the quickest change you may notice
segments.tr: ## Fiscalização (oversight): a mudança mais rápida que você pode notar

segments.tr: A mudança mais imediata sob uma nova maioria costuma ser o escrutínio, e não a legislação.

segments.tr: - Solicitar auditorias e relatórios de agências de fiscalização

segments.src: If the Senate also changes hands, the effects extend to **confirmations**.
segments.tr: Se o Senado também mudar de mãos, os efeitos se estendem às **confirmações**.

segments.src: The Senate approves cabinet officials, judges and other senior appointments, so a different majority can slow, reshape or block nominations.
segments.tr: O Senado aprova oficiais do gabinete, juízes e outras nomeações de alto escalão, de modo que uma maioria diferente pode retardar, remodelar ou bloquear indicações.

segments.src: The House also holds the power to impeach, but conviction requires two-thirds of the Senate, a very high bar.
segments.tr: A Câmara também detém o poder de impeachment, mas a condenação exige dois terços do Senado, um patamar muito alto.

segments.src: Historically, impeachment has been rare and has not resulted in removal.
segments.tr: Historicamente, o impeachment tem sido raro e não resultou em destituição.

segments.src: ## Reality check: divided government is still divided
segments.tr: ## Realidade: o governo dividido continua dividido

segments.src: Even if both chambers flip, Washington would remain a system of shared power.
segments.tr: Mesmo que ambas as casas mudem de lado, Washington continuará a ser um sistema de poder compartilhado.

segments.src: A president of the other party retains the veto, executive orders, enforcement discretion and the ability to direct agencies.

segments.tr: Hingga saat itu, Kongres saat ini tetap menjabat, termasuk selama sesi "bebek lumpuh" di bulan Desember.

segments.src: Even after the handoff, the president keeps the executive branch, the veto pen and most day-to-day regulatory decisions.
segments.tr: Bahkan setelah penyerahan kekuasaan, presiden tetap memegang cabang eksekutif, hak veto, dan sebagian besar keputusan regulasi sehari-hari.

segments.src: That means voter anger over prices does not translate into an immediate policy shift.
segments.tr: Itu berarti kemarahan pemilih atas harga tidak diterjemahkan menjadi perubahan kebijakan yang langsung.

segments.src: Congress sets the rules and the money.
segments.tr: Kongres menetapkan aturan dan anggaran.

segments.src: The White House carries them out.
segments.tr: Gedung Putih yang menjalankannya.

segments.src: ## Prices: Congress has indirect levers, not a price dial
segments.tr: ## Harga: Kongres memiliki tuas tidak langsung, bukan tombol harga

segments.src: No branch of government can directly set the price of groceries, rent or gasoline.
segments.tr: Tidak ada cabang pemerintahan yang dapat menetapkan harga bahan makanan, sewa, atau bensin secara langsung.

segments.src: Inflation and affordability are shaped by interest rates (set by the independent Federal Reserve), supply chains, energy markets, wages, housing supply and trade policy.
segments.tr: Inflasi dan keterjangkauan dibentuk oleh suku bunga (yang ditetapkan oleh Federal Reserve independen), rantai pasokan, pasar energi, upah, pasokan perumahan, dan kebijakan perdagangan.

segments.src: What Congress can influence:
segments.tr: Apa yang dapat dipengaruhi oleh Kongres:

segments.src: - **Taxes and credits.** Changes to tax law can alter what families keep, but most major tax legislation needs 60 votes in the Senate unless it moves through the budget reconciliation process.
segments.tr: - **Pajak dan kredit.** Perubahan pada undang-undang pajak dapat mengubah apa yang disimpan oleh keluarga, tetapi sebagian besar undang-undang pajak utama membutuhkan 60 suara di Senat kecuali jika melalui proses rekonsiliasi anggaran.

segments.src: - **Spending programs.** Funding for housing, food assistance, health subsidies and energy programs is set in law.
segments.tr: - **Program belanja.** Pendanaan untuk perumahan, bantuan makanan, subsidi kesehatan, dan program energi ditetapkan dalam undang-undang.

segments.src: - **Trade rules.** Tariffs are taxes on imports, and the Constitution gives Congress the power to levy them (more below).
segments.tr: - **Aturan perdagangan.** Tarif adalah pajak atas impor, dan Konstitusi memberi Kongres kekuatan untuk mengenakannya (selengkapnya di bawah).

segments.src: - **Regulatory pressure.** Hearings, funding limits and statutory changes can push agencies in a different direction.
segments.tr: - **Tekanan regulasi.** Dengar pendapat, batas pendanaan, dan perubahan undang-undang dapat mendorong lembaga-lembaga ke arah yang berbeda.

segments.src: What it cannot do quickly: lower mortgage rates, reverse global commodity swings or override the Fed.
segments.tr: Apa yang tidak dapat dilakukannya dengan cepat: menurunkan suku bunga hipotek, membalikkan gejolak komoditas global, atau mengabaikan Fed.

segments.src: Economists generally caution that policy changes take months or years to show up in household budgets.
segments.tr: Para ekonom secara umum memperingatkan bahwa perubahan kebijakan membutuhkan waktu berbulan-bulan atau bertahun-tahun untuk muncul dalam anggaran rumah tangga.

segments.src: ## Tariffs: Congress holds the power on paper, but the veto looms
segments.tr: ## Tarif: Kongres memegang kekuasaan di atas kertas, tetapi bayang-bayang veto mengintai

segments.src: Under the Constitution, the power to impose tariffs belongs to Congress.
segments.tr: Berdasarkan Konstitusi, kekuatan untuk mengenakan tarif ada pada Kongres.

segments.src: Over decades, lawmakers have delegated broad authority to the president through laws such as Section 232 (national security), Section 301 (unfair trade practices) and emergency statutes.
segments.tr: Selama dekade-dekade, para pembuat undang-undang telah mendelegasikan wewenang luas kepada presiden melalui undang-undang seperti Bagian 232 (keamanan nasional), Bagian 301 (praktik perdagangan tidak adil), dan undang-undang darurat.

segments.src: Much of recent tariff policy has relied on those delegations, and some of them have been challenged in court.
segments.tr: Sebagian besar kebijakan tarif baru-baru ini telah mengandalkan pendelegasian tersebut, dan beberapa di antaranya telah digugat di pengadilan.

segments.src: A Democratic-controlled Congress could try to:
segments.tr: Kongres yang dikuasai Demokrat dapat mencoba untuk:

segments.src: 1. **Pass legislation** narrowing or ending specific tariff authorities.
segments.tr: 1. **Mengesahkan undang-undang** yang mempersempit atau mengakhiri wewenang tarif tertentu.

segments.src: 2. **Use disapproval resolutions**, where the law provides for them, to terminate emergency declarations that underpin certain tariffs.
segments.tr: 2. **Menggunakan resolusi penolakan**, di mana undang-undang menyediakannya, untuk mengakhiri deklarasi darurat yang mendasari tarif tertentu.

segments.src: 3. **Hold hearings** that require officials to explain costs, exemptions and effects on consumers and businesses.
segments.tr: 3. **Mengadakan dengar pendapat** yang mengharuskan pejabat untuk menjelaskan biaya, pengecualian, dan efek pada konsumen dan bisnis.

segments.src: 4. **Attach conditions** to must-pass legislation.
segments.tr: 4. **Menyertakan ketentuan** pada undang-undang yang wajib disahkan.

segments.src: The obstacle is arithmetic.
segments.tr: Hambatannya adalah aritmatika.

segments.src: A president can veto a bill, and overriding a veto requires two-thirds of both chambers.
segments.tr: Seorang presiden dapat memveto RUU, dan mengesampingkan veto membutuhkan dua pertiga dari kedua kamar.

segments.src: Unless a meaningful number of Republicans join, a veto would likely stand.
segments.tr: Kecuali jika sejumlah besar dari Partai Republik bergabung, veto tersebut kemungkinan akan tetap berlaku.

segments.src: Tariff skepticism has existed in both parties and among many business groups, so cross-party coalitions are possible, but they are not guaranteed.
segments.tr: Skeptisisme tarif telah ada di kedua partai dan di antara banyak kelompok bisnis, sehingga koalisi lintas partai dimungkinkan, tetapi hal tersebut tidak dijamin.

segments.src: Courts also matter.
segments.tr: Pengadilan juga penting.

segments.src: Judicial rulings on how far presidential tariff authority extends can reshape the debate regardless of who controls Congress.
segments.tr: Putusan yudisial tentang seberapa jauh wewenang tarif presiden dapat membentuk kembali perdebatan terlepas dari siapa yang mengendalikan Kongres.

segments.src: ## The budget: where the "power of the purse" becomes real
segments.tr: ## Anggaran: tempat di mana "kekuatan dompet" menjadi nyata

segments.src: Congress's strongest tool is funding.
segments.tr: Alat terkuat Kongres adalah pendanaan.

segments.src: Federal agencies operate on annual appropriations, and the fiscal year begins October 1.
segments.tr: Lembaga federal beroperasi berdasarkan alokasi tahunan, dan tahun fiskal dimulai pada 1 Oktober.

segments.src: A new majority gains leverage in several ways:
segments.tr: Mayoritas baru memperoleh pengaruh dalam beberapa cara:

segments.src: - **Appropriations bills.** The House originates spending bills, and the Senate must also pass them. A majority in both chambers lets Democrats shape priorities, set funding levels and add policy guardrails.
segments.tr: - **RUU Alokasi.** DPR memulai RUU pengeluaran, dan Senat juga harus mengesahkannya. Mayoritas di kedua kamar memungkinkan Demokrat membentuk prioritas, menetapkan tingkat pendanaan, dan menambahkan pembatas kebijakan.

segments.src: - **Shutdown brinkmanship.** If the two branches cannot agree, funding lapses. Shutdowns are costly and politically risky for everyone involved, which is why most fights end in compromise.
segments.tr: - **Kebijakan tepi jurang penutupan.** Jika kedua cabang tidak dapat mencapai kesepakatan, pendanaan akan kedaluwarsa. Penutupan sangat mahal dan berisiko secara politik bagi semua pihak yang terlibat, itulah sebabnya sebagian besar pertikaian berakhir dengan kompromi.

segments.src: - **Continuing resolutions and deadlines.** Short-term funding extensions often become the real negotiating moments.
segments.tr: - **Resolusi lanjutan dan batas waktu.** Perpanjangan pendanaan jangka pendek sering kali menjadi momen negosiasi yang sebenarnya.

segments.src: - **The debt limit.** Raising or suspending it is required to pay obligations already incurred, and it has repeatedly become a flashpoint.
segments.tr: - **Batas utang.** Menaikkan atau menangguhkannya diperlukan untuk membayar kewajiban yang sudah terjadi, dan hal ini telah berulang kali menjadi titik nyala.

segments.src: The limits: the Senate filibuster still requires 60 votes for most legislation, unless the rules change.
segments.tr: Batasannya: filibuster Senat masih membutuhkan 60 suara untuk sebagian besar undang-undang, kecuali aturannya berubah.

segments.src: Any spending bill still needs the president's signature, so a final budget would be a negotiated outcome, not a one-party wish list.
segments.tr: Setiap RUU pengeluaran masih memerlukan tanda tangan presiden, sehingga anggaran akhir akan menjadi hasil negosiasi, bukan daftar keinginan satu partai.

segments.src: The president can also affect how funds are spent through administrative choices, which is a frequent source of disputes.
segments.tr: Presiden juga dapat memengaruhi bagaimana dana dibelanjakan melalui pilihan administratif, yang merupakan sumber sengketa yang sering terjadi.

segments.src: ## Oversight: the quickest change you may notice
segments.tr: ## Pengawasan: perubahan tercepat yang mungkin Anda perhatikan

segments.src: The most immediate shift under a new majority is often not legislation but scrutiny.
segments.tr: Perubahan paling langsung di bawah mayoritas baru sering kali bukanlah undang-undang melainkan pengawasan.

segments.src: Committee chairs control agendas, and they can:
segments.tr: Ketua komite mengendalikan agenda, dan mereka dapat:

segments.src: - Schedule hearings and call witnesses
segments.tr: - Menjadwalkan dengar pendapat dan memanggil saksi

segments.src: - Issue subpoenas for documents and testimony
segments.tr: - Menerbitkan panggilan pengadilan untuk dokumen dan kesaksian

segments.src: - Request audits and reports from watchdog agencies
segments.tr: - Meminta audit dan laporan dari lembaga pengawas

segments.src: - Investigate agency decisions, contracts and spending
segments.tr: - Menyelidiki keputusan lembaga, kontrak, dan pengeluaran

segments.src: If the Senate also changes hands, the effects extend to **confirmations**.
segments.tr: Jika Senat juga berpindah tangan, dampaknya meluas ke **konfirmasi**.

segments.src: The Senate approves cabinet officials, judges and other senior appointments, so a different majority can slow, reshape or block nominations.
segments.tr: Senat menyetujui pejabat kabinet, hakim, dan penunjukan senior lainnya, sehingga mayoritas yang berbeda dapat memperlambat, membentuk kembali, atau memblokir nominasi.

segments.src: The House also holds the power to impeach, but conviction requires two-thirds of the Senate, a very high bar.
segments.tr: DPR juga memegang kekuasaan untuk memakzulkan, tetapi keyakinan membutuhkan dua pertiga dari Senat, sebuah batasan yang sangat tinggi.

segments.src: Historically, impeachment has been rare and has not resulted in removal.
segments.tr: Secara historis, pemakzulan jarang terjadi dan belum menghasilkan pencopotan.

segments.src: ## Reality check: divided government is still divided
segments.tr: ## Pemeriksaan realitas: pemerintahan yang terpecah tetaplah terpecah

segments.src: Even if both chambers flip, Washington would remain a system of shared power.
segments.tr: Bahkan jika kedua kamar berbalik, Washington akan tetap menjadi sistem kekuasaan bersama.

segments.src: A president of the other party retains the veto, executive orders, enforcement discretion and the ability to direct agencies.
segments.tr: Presiden dari partai lain tetap mempertahankan veto, perintah eksekutif, keleluasaan penegakan hukum, dan kemampuan untuk mengarahkan lembaga.

segments.src: Expect:
segments.tr: Harapkan:

segments.src: - **Gridlock on major bills**, with compromise limited to must-pass items such as funding.
segments.tr: - **Kebuntuan pada RUU besar**, dengan kompromi terbatas pada hal-hal yang wajib disahkan seperti pendanaan.

segments.src: - **A heavy calendar of hearings** and investigations.
segments.tr: - **Kalender dengar pendapat dan investigasi yang padat**.

segments.src: - **Messaging votes** designed to frame choices ahead of 2028.
segments.tr: - **Suara penyampaian pesan** yang dirancang untuk membingkai pilihan menjelang 2028.

segments.src: - **Court battles** over the boundaries of executive and legislative authority.
segments.tr: - **Pertempuran pengadilan** atas batas-batas wewenang eksekutif dan legislatif.

segments.src: ## What to watch before 2028
segments.tr: ## Apa yang harus diperhatikan sebelum 2028

segments.src: - **Certified results and final margins.** Narrow majorities make party discipline and absences matter.
segments.tr: - **Hasil yang disetujui dan margin akhir.** Mayoritas yang tipis membuat kedisiplinan partai dan ketidakhadiran menjadi penting.

segments.src: - **The next funding deadline.** It is the first big test of how the two branches work together.
segments.tr: - **Batas waktu pendanaan berikutnya.** Ini adalah ujian besar pertama tentang bagaimana kedua cabang bekerja sama.

segments.src: - **Tariff developments.** Look for court decisions, trade negotiations and any bipartisan bills.
segments.tr: - **Perkembangan tarif.** Cari keputusan pengadilan, negosiasi perdagangan, dan RUU bipartisan apa pun.

segments.src: - **Economic data.** Monthly inflation reports, wage growth and Fed decisions will shape the political mood more than any single vote.
segments.tr: - **Data ekonomi.** Laporan inflasi bulanan, pertumbuhan upah, dan keputusan Fed akan membentuk suasana politik lebih dari satu suara tunggal.

segments.src: - **Committee leadership.** Who chairs key panels signals which issues get priority.
segments.tr: - **Kepemimpinan komite.** Siapa yang memimpin panel kunci menandakan masalah mana yang mendapat prioritas.

segments.src: ## Bottom line
segments.tr: ## Kesimpulan

segments.src: A change in congressional control can reshape the agenda, the budget fights and the level of scrutiny in Washington.
segments.tr: Perubahan dalam kendali kongres dapat membentuk kembali agenda, pertikaian anggaran, dan tingkat pengawasan di Washington.

segments.src: It is much less likely to produce rapid, sweeping changes to prices or trade policy without cooperation from the White House.
segments.tr: Hal tersebut jauh lebih kecil kemungkinannya untuk menghasilkan perubahan yang cepat dan menyeluruh pada harga atau kebijakan perdagangan tanpa kerja sama dari Gedung Putih.

segments.src: For readers, the practical takeaway is to watch what is passed and signed into law, and not only what is debated.
segments.tr: Bagi para pembaca, kesimpulan praktisnya adalah untuk memperhatikan apa yang disahkan dan ditandatangani menjadi undang-undang, dan bukan hanya apa yang diperdebatkan.

segments.tr: *Artikel ini adalah untuk informasi umum dan bukan merupakan nasihat keuangan, hukum, atau investasi.

ja.title: もはや分断は終わったのか？民主党の中間選挙の波が物価、関税、予算に意味するもの

segments.src: Early reports indicate that Democrats have won control of both the House and the Senate in the 2026 midterm elections, with frustration over the cost of living cited as a central theme among voters.
segments.tr: 初期の報道によると、2026年の中間選挙で民主党が下院と上院の両方で過半数を獲得したことが示されており、有権者の間では生活費の高騰に対する不満が主要なテーマとして挙げられています。

segments.src: Final tallies and certification can take weeks, so treat any single count with caution.
segments.tr: 最終的な集計と認定には数週間かかる場合があるため、個々の集計結果は慎重に扱う必要があります。

segments.src: The more useful question for most households is this: **if control of Congress changes hands, what can lawmakers actually do, and what stays out of their reach?**
segments.tr: 大半の世帯にとってより有益な疑問は、「**もし議会の主導権が移行した場合、立法府は実際に何ができ、何がその手の届かないところにあるのか？**」ということです。

segments.src: This explainer walks through the constitutional tools a new Congress has, the limits it faces, and what to watch between now and the 2028 election.
segments.tr: この記事では、新議会が持つ憲法上の権限、直面する限界、そして現在から2028年の選挙にかけて注目すべき点について解説します。

segments.src: It is a look at how the system works, not an endorsement of any party or policy.
segments.tr: これはシステムがどのように機能するかを見るものであり、特定の政党や政策を支持するものではありません。

segments.src: ## The timeline: nothing changes overnight
segments.tr: ## タイムライン：一晩で何も変わらない

segments.src: A newly elected Congress is sworn in on January 3, 2027.
segments.tr: 新しく選出された議会は2027年1月3日に就任します。

segments.src: Until then, the current Congress remains in office, including during any "lame-duck" session in December.
segments.tr: それまでは、12月の「レームダック」セッションを含め、現職の議会が任期を続けます。

segments.src: Even after the handoff, the president keeps the executive branch, the veto pen and most day-to-day regulatory decisions.
segments.tr: 引き継ぎが行われた後も、大統領は行政権、拒否権、そして日常の規制に関する決定の大半を維持します。

segments.src: That means voter anger over prices does not translate into an immediate policy shift.
segments.tr: つまり、物価に対する有権者の怒りが直ちに政策転換につながるわけではありません。

segments.src: Congress sets the rules and the money.
segments.tr: 議会がルールと予算を定め、

segments.src: The White House carries them out.
segments.tr: ホワイトハウスがそれを実行します。

segments.src: ## Prices: Congress has indirect levers, not a price dial
segments.tr: ## 物価：議会が持つのは間接的なレバーであり、価格調整ダイヤルではない

segments.src: No branch of government can directly set the price of groceries, rent or gasoline.
segments.tr: 政府のどの部門も、食料品、家賃、ガソリンの価格を直接設定することはできません。

segments.src: Inflation and affordability are shaped by interest rates (set by the independent Federal Reserve), supply chains, energy markets, wages, housing supply and trade policy.
segments.tr: インフレと生活費の負担は、金利（独立した連邦準備制度が設定）、サプライチェーン、エネルギー市場、賃金、住宅供給、貿易政策によって形作られます。

segments.src: What Congress can influence:
segments.tr: 議会が影響を与えられるもの：

segments.src: - **Taxes and credits.** Changes to tax law can alter what families keep, but most major tax legislation needs 60 votes in the Senate unless it moves through the budget reconciliation process.
segments.tr: - **税金と控除。** 税法の変更によって家族の手元に残る金額を変えることはできますが、ほとんどの主要な税制法案は、予算調整プロセスを経ない限り、上院で60票を必要とします。

segments.src: - **Spending programs.** Funding for housing, food assistance, health subsidies and energy programs is set in law.
segments.tr: - **支出プログラム。** 住宅、食料支援、医療補助金、エネルギープログラムへの資金提供は法律で定められています。

segments.src: - **Trade rules.** Tariffs are taxes on imports, and the Constitution gives Congress the power to levy them (more below).
segments.tr: - **貿易ルール。** 関税は輸入品に対する税金であり、憲法は議会にこれを課す権限を与えています（詳細は後述）。

segments.src: - **Regulatory pressure.** Hearings, funding limits and statutory changes can push agencies in a different direction.
segments.tr: - **規制上の圧力。** 公聴会、予算の制限、法律の変更を通じて、機関を異なる方向に導くことができます。

segments.src: What it cannot do quickly: lower mortgage rates, reverse global commodity swings or override the Fed.
segments.tr: 迅速には実行できないこと：住宅ローン金利の引き下げ、世界的な商品価格の変動の逆転、またはFRBの決定の無効化。

segments.src: Economists generally caution that policy changes take months or years to show up in household budgets.
segments.tr: 経済学者らは一般的に、政策変更が家計の予算に反映されるには数ヶ月から数年かかると警告しています。

segments.src: ## Tariffs: Congress holds the power on paper, but the veto looms
segments.tr: ## 関税：紙の上では議会が権限を持つが、拒否権がちらつく

segments.src: Under the Constitution, the power to impose tariffs belongs to Congress.
segments.tr: 憲法の下では、関税を課す権限は議会に属しています。

segments.src: Over decades, lawmakers have delegated broad authority to the president through laws such as Section 232 (national security), Section 301 (unfair trade practices) and emergency statutes.
segments.tr: 数十年にわたり、議員らは通商拡大法232条（国家安全保障）、301条（不公正な貿易慣行）、および緊急事態関連法などの法律を通じて、大統領に幅広い権限を委任してきました。

segments.src: Much of recent tariff policy has relied on those delegations, and some of them have been challenged in court.
segments.tr: 最近の関税政策の多くはそうした委任に依存しており、その一部は法廷で争われてきました。

segments.src: A Democratic-controlled Congress could try to:
segments.tr: 民主党が主導する議会が試みる可能性のあること：

segments.src: 1. **Pass legislation** narrowing or ending specific tariff authorities.
segments.tr: 1. **特定の関税権限を制限または廃止する立法の可決。**

segments.src: 2. **Use disapproval resolutions**, where the law provides for them, to terminate emergency declarations that underpin certain tariffs.
segments.tr: 2. **法律が認めている場合、特定の関税の根拠となっている緊急事態宣言を終了させるための不同意決議の使用。**

segments.src: 3. **Hold hearings** that require officials to explain costs, exemptions and effects on consumers and businesses.
segments.tr: 3. **政府高官に対し、コスト、免除措置、および消費者や企業への影響の説明を求める公聴会の開催。**

segments.src: 4. **Attach conditions** to must-pass legislation.
segments.tr: 4. **成立が不可欠な法案への条件の付加。**

segments.src: The obstacle is arithmetic.
segments.tr: 障害となるのは数である。

segments.src: A president can veto a bill, and overriding a veto requires two-thirds of both chambers.
segments.tr: 大統領は法案に拒否権を発動することができ、拒否権を覆すには両院の3分の2の賛成が必要となる。

segments.src: Unless a meaningful number of Republicans join, a veto would likely stand.
segments.tr: かなりの数の共和党議員が加わらない限り、拒否権はおそらく維持されるだろう。

segments.src: Tariff skepticism has existed in both parties and among many business groups, so cross-party coalitions are possible, but they are not guaranteed.
segments.tr: 関税に対する懐疑論は両党および多くのビジネスグループに存在するため、超党派の連合は可能であるが、保証はされていない。

segments.src: Courts also matter.
segments.tr: 裁判所も重要である。

segments.src: Judicial rulings on how far presidential tariff authority extends can reshape the debate regardless of who controls Congress.
segments.tr: 大統領の関税権限がどこまで及ぶかに関する司法判断は、誰が議会を統制しているかに関わらず、議論の形を変える可能性がある。

segments.src: ## The budget: where the "power of the purse" becomes real
segments.tr: ## 予算：「予算編成権」が現実のものとなる場所

segments.src: Congress's strongest tool is funding.
segments.tr: 議会の最も強力なツールは資金提供である。

segments.src: Federal agencies operate on annual appropriations, and the fiscal year begins October 1.
segments.tr: 連邦機関は年間予算に基づいて運営されており、会計年度は10月1日に始まる。

segments.src: A new majority gains leverage in several ways:
segments.tr: 新しい過半数派は、いくつかの方法で影響力を獲得する：

segments.src: - **Appropriations bills.** The House originates spending bills, and the Senate must also pass them. A majority in both chambers lets Democrats shape priorities, set funding levels and add policy guardrails.
segments.tr: - **歳出法案。** 下院が支出法案を提出し、上院もそれを可決しなければならない。両院の過半数により、民主党は優先順位を形作り、資金の水準を設定し、政策のガードレールを追加することができる。

segments.src: - **Shutdown brinkmanship.** If the two branches cannot agree, funding lapses. Shutdowns are costly and politically risky for everyone involved, which is why most fights end in compromise.
segments.tr: - **政府閉鎖を巡るギリギリの駆け引き。** 両部門が合意できない場合、資金が失効する。政府閉鎖は費用がかかり、関係者全員にとって政治的リスクが伴うため、ほとんどの争いは妥協で終わる。

segments.src: - **Continuing resolutions and deadlines.** Short-term funding extensions often become the real negotiating moments.
segments.tr: - **つなぎ予算と期限。** 短期的な資金延長は、しばしば実際の交渉の瞬間となる。

segments.src: - **The debt limit.** Raising or suspending it is required to pay obligations already incurred, and it has repeatedly become a flashpoint.
segments.tr: - **債務上限。** すでに発生した債務を支払うためには、上限の引き上げまたは一時停止が必要であり、これが繰り返し火種となっている。

segments.src: The limits: the Senate filibuster still requires 60 votes for most legislation, unless the rules change.
segments.tr: 限界：上院のフィリバスター（議事妨害）は、ルールが変更されない限り、依然としてほとんどの法案に60票を必要とする。

segments.src: Any spending bill still needs the president's signature, so a final budget would be a negotiated outcome, not a one-party wish list.
segments.tr: いかなる支出法案も依然として大統領の署名を必要とするため、最終的な予算は一党の希望リストではなく、交渉による結果となる。

segments.src: The president can also affect how funds are spent through administrative choices, which is a frequent source of disputes.
segments.tr: 大統領はまた、行政上の選択を通じて資金の使途に影響を与えることもでき、これが紛争の頻繁な原因となっている。

segments.src: ## Oversight: the quickest change you may notice
segments.tr: ## 監督：最も早く気づくかもしれない変化

segments.src: The most immediate shift under a new majority is often not legislation but scrutiny.
segments.tr: 新しい過半数のもとでの最も直接的な変化は、多くの場合、立法ではなく監視である。

segments.src: Committee chairs control agendas, and they can:
segments.tr: 委員会の委員長はアジェンダを管理し、以下のことが可能である：

segments.src: - Schedule hearings and call witnesses
segments.tr: - 公聴会のスケジュール設定と証人の召喚

segments.src: - Issue subpoenas for documents and testimony
segments.tr: - 文書および証言に対する召喚状の発行

segments.src: - Request audits and reports from watchdog agencies
segments.tr: - 監視機関への監査および報告書の要求

segments.src: - Investigate agency decisions, contracts and spending
segments.tr: - 機関の決定、契約、支出の調査

segments.src: If the Senate also changes hands, the effects extend to **confirmations**.
segments.tr: 上院の主導権も変わる場合、その影響は**人事承認**にまで及ぶ。

segments.src: The Senate approves cabinet officials, judges and other senior appointments, so a different majority can slow, reshape or block nominations.
segments.tr: 上院は閣僚、判事、その他の高官の任命を承認するため、異なる過半数派は指名を遅らせたり、見直したり、阻止したりすることができる。

segments.src: The House also holds the power to impeach, but conviction requires two-thirds of the Senate, a very high bar.
segments.tr: 下院には弾劾する権限もあるが、有罪判決には上院の3分の2の賛成が必要であり、非常に高いハードルである。

segments.src: Historically, impeachment has been rare and has not resulted in removal.
segments.tr: 歴史的に見て、弾劾は稀であり、解任につながったことはない。

segments.src: ## Reality check: divided government is still divided
segments.tr: ## 現実逃避のない検証：分断された政府は依然として分断されている

segments.src: Even if both chambers flip, Washington would remain a system of shared power.
segments.tr: 両院が覆ったとしても、ワシントンは依然として権力が分散されたシステムであり続ける。

segments.src: A president of the other party retains the veto, executive orders, enforcement discretion and the ability to direct agencies.
segments.tr: 他党の大統領は、拒否権、大統領令、執行の裁量、そして機関を指揮する能力を保持し続ける。

segments.src: Expect:
segments.tr: 予想されること：

segments.src: - **Gridlock on major bills**, with compromise limited to must-pass items such as funding.
segments.tr: - **主要法案におけるこう着状態**、妥協は資金提供などの不可欠な項目に限定される。

segments.src: - **A heavy calendar of hearings** and investigations.
segments.tr: - **多忙な公聴会と調査のスケジュール**。

segments.src: - **Messaging votes** designed to frame choices ahead of 2028.
segments.tr: - **2028年に向けた選択肢を枠付けるために設計されたメッセージ投票**。

segments.src: - **Court battles** over the boundaries of executive and legislative authority.
segments.tr: - **行政権と立法権の境界をめぐる法廷闘争**。

segments.src: ## What to watch before 2028
segments.tr: ## 2028年までに注目すべき点

segments.src: - **Certified results and final margins.** Narrow majorities make party discipline and absences matter.
segments.tr: - **確定した結果と最終的な議席差。** わずかな過半数では、党の統率力や欠席が重要になる。

segments.src: - **The next funding deadline.** It is the first big test of how the two branches work together.
segments.tr: - **次の資金期限。** 両部門がどのように協力して働くかを示す最初の大きな試金石である。

segments.src: - **Tariff developments.** Look for court decisions, trade negotiations and any bipartisan bills.
segments.tr: - **関税の動向。** 裁判所の判決、貿易交渉、そして超党派の法案に注目する。

segments.src: - **Economic data.** Monthly inflation reports, wage growth and Fed decisions will shape the political mood more than any single vote.
segments.tr: - **経済データ。** 月次インフレ報告、賃金の伸び、FRBの決定は、単一の投票よりも政治的なムードを形作る。

segments.src: - **Committee leadership.** Who chairs key panels signals which issues get priority.
segments.tr: - **委員会の指導部。** 主要なパネルの議長を務める人物が、どの問題が優先されるかを示している。

segments.src: ## Bottom line
segments.tr: ## 結論

segments.src: A change in congressional control can reshape the agenda, the budget fights and the level of scrutiny in Washington.
segments.tr: 議会の主導権の変更は、ワシントンにおけるアジェンダ、予算闘争、監視のレベルを再定義する可能性がある。

segments.src: It is much less likely to produce rapid, sweeping changes to prices or trade policy without cooperation from the White House.
segments.tr: ホワイトハウスからの協力なしに、物価や貿易政策に急速で広範な変化をもたらす可能性ははるかに低い。

segments.src: For readers, the practical takeaway is to watch what is passed and signed into law, and not only what is debated.
segments.tr: 読者にとっての実践的な要点は、議論されていることだけでなく、何が可決され法律として署名されたかに注目することである。

de.title: Nicht länger geteilt? Was eine demokratische Zwischenwahlwelle für Preise, Zölle und den Haushalt bedeuten könnte

segments.src: Early reports indicate that Democrats have won control of both the House and the Senate in the 2026 midterm elections, with frustration over the cost of living cited as a central theme among voters.
segments.tr: Erste Berichte deuten darauf hin, dass die Demokraten bei den Zwischenwahlen 2026 die Kontrolle über sowohl das Repräsentantenhaus als auch den Senat gewonnen haben, wobei Frustration über die Lebenshaltungskosten als zentrales Thema unter Wählern genannt wird.

segments.src: Final tallies and certification can take weeks, so treat any single count with caution.
segments.tr: Endergebnisse und die Bestätigung können Wochen dauern, behandeln Sie also jede einzelne Auszählung mit Vorsicht.

segments.src: The more useful question for most households is this: **if control of Congress changes hands, what can lawmakers actually do, and what stays out of their reach?**
segments.tr: Die nützlichere Frage für die meisten Haushalte ist diese: **Wenn die Kontrolle über den Kongress die Seite wechselt, was können Gesetzgeber tatsächlich tun und was bleibt außerhalb ihrer Reichweite?**

segments.src: This explainer walks through the constitutional tools a new Congress has, the limits it faces, and what to watch between now and the 2028 election.
segments.tr: Dieser Erklärungstext führt durch die verfassungsmäßigen Werkzeuge, die ein neuer Kongress hat, die Grenzen, denen er gegenübersteht, und was von jetzt bis zur Wahl 2028 zu beobachten ist.

segments.src: It is a look at how the system works, not an endorsement of any party or policy.
segments.tr: Dies ist ein Blick darauf, wie das System funktioniert, keine Befürwortung einer Partei oder Politik.

segments.src: ## The timeline: nothing changes overnight
segments.tr: ## Der Zeitplan: Nichts ändert sich über Nacht

segments.src: A newly elected Congress is sworn in on January 3, 2027.
segments.tr: Ein neu gewählter Kongress wird am 3. Januar 2027 vereidigt.

segments.src: Until then, the current Congress remains in office, including during any "lame-duck" session in December.
segments.tr: Bis dahin bleibt der aktuelle Kongress im Amt, einschließlich während jeder Sitzung der "lame ducks" im Dezember.

segments.src: Even after the handoff, the president keeps the executive branch, the veto pen and most day-to-day regulatory decisions.
segments.tr: Sogar nach der Übergabe behält der Präsident die Exekutive, das Veto-Recht und die meisten alltäglichen regulatorischen Entscheidungen.

segments.src: That means voter anger over prices does not translate into an immediate policy shift.
segments.tr: Das bedeutet, dass Wählerwut über Preise nicht zu einer unmittelbaren politischen Verschiebung führt.

segments.src: Congress sets the rules and the money.
segments.tr: Der Kongress legt die Regeln und das Geld fest.

segments.src: The White House carries them out.
segments.tr: Das Weiße Haus setzt sie um.

segments.src: ## Prices: Congress has indirect levers, not a price dial
segments.tr: ## Preise: Der Kongress hat indirekte Hebel, keinen Preisregler

segments.src: No branch of government can directly set the price of groceries, rent or gasoline.
segments.tr: Kein Regierungszweig kann direkt den Preis für Lebensmittel, Miete oder Benzin festlegen.

segments.src: Inflation and affordability are shaped by interest rates (set by the independent Federal Reserve), supply chains, energy markets, wages, housing supply and trade policy.
segments.tr: Inflation und Erschwinglichkeit werden durch Zinssätze (festgelegt von der unabhängigen Federal Reserve), Lieferketten, Energiemärkte, Löhne, das Wohnungsangebot und die Handelspolitik geprägt.

segments.src: What Congress can influence:
segments.tr: Was der Kongress beeinflussen kann:

segments.src: - **Taxes and credits.** Changes to tax law can alter what families keep, but most major tax legislation needs 60 votes in the Senate unless it moves through the budget reconciliation process.
segments.tr: - **Steuern und Gutschriften.** Änderungen des Steuerrechts können verändern, was Familien behalten, aber die meisten großen Steuergesetze benötigen 60 Stimmen im Senat, es sei denn, sie laufen über den Haushaltsabstimmungsprozess.

segments.src: - **Spending programs.** Funding for housing, food assistance, health subsidies and energy programs is set in law.
segments.tr: - **Ausgabenprogramme.** Die Finanzierung für Wohnen, Nahrungsmittelhilfe, Gesundheitssubventionen und Energieprogramme ist gesetzlich festgelegt.

segments.src: - **Trade rules.** Tariffs are taxes on imports, and the Constitution gives Congress the power to levy them (more below).
segments.tr: - **Handelsregeln.** Zölle sind Steuern auf Importe, und die Verfassung gibt dem Kongress die Macht, sie zu erheben (siehe unten).

segments.src: - **Regulatory pressure.** Hearings, funding limits and statutory changes can push agencies in a different direction.
segments.tr: - **Regulatorischer Druck.** Anhörungen, Finanzierungsgrenzen und gesetzliche Änderungen können Behörden in eine andere Richtung drängen.

segments.src: What it cannot do quickly: lower mortgage rates, reverse global commodity swings or override the Fed.
segments.tr: Was er nicht schnell tun kann: Hypothekenzinsen senken, globale Rohstoffschwankungen umkehren oder die Fed überstimmen.

segments.src: Economists generally caution that policy changes take months or years to show up in household budgets.
segments.tr: Ökonomen warnen im Allgemeinen, dass politische Änderungen Monate oder Jahre brauchen, um sich in Haushaltsbudgets zu zeigen.

segments.src: ## Tariffs: Congress holds the power on paper, but the veto looms
segments.tr: ## Zölle: Der Kongress hat die Macht auf dem Papier, aber das Veto droht

segments.src: Under the Constitution, the power to impose tariffs belongs to Congress.
segments.tr: Unter der Verfassung liegt die Macht, Zölle zu erheben, beim Kongress.

segments.src: Over decades, lawmakers have delegated broad authority to the president through laws such as Section 232 (national security), Section 301 (unfair trade practices) and emergency statutes.
segments.tr: Über Jahrzehnte haben Gesetzgeber dem Präsidenten durch Gesetze wie Abschnitt 232 (nationale Sicherheit), Abschnitt 301 (unfaire Handelspraktiken) und Notstandsgesetze eine breite Autorität übertragen.

segments.src: Much of recent tariff policy has relied on those delegations, and some of them have been challenged in court.
segments.tr: Ein Großteil der jüngeren Zollpolitik hat sich auf diese Delegationen gestützt, und einige davon wurden vor Gericht angefochten.

segments.src: A Democratic-controlled Congress could try to:
segments.tr: Ein demokratisch kontrollierter Kongress könnte versuchen:

segments.src: 1. **Pass legislation** narrowing or ending specific tariff authorities.
segments.tr: 1. **Gesetzgebung zu verabschieden**, die spezifische Zollbefugnisse einschränkt oder beendet.

segments.src: 2. **Use disapproval resolutions**, where the law provides for them, to terminate emergency declarations that underpin certain tariffs.
segments.tr: 2. **Missbilligungsresolutionen zu nutzen**, wo das Gesetz dies vorsieht, um Notstandserklärungen zu beenden, die bestimmte Zölle untermauern.

segments.src: 3. **Hold hearings** that require officials to explain costs, exemptions and effects on consumers and businesses.
segments.tr: 3. **Anhörungen abzuhalten**, die Beamte verpflichten, Kosten, Ausnahmen und Auswirkungen auf Verbraucher und Unternehmen zu erklären.

segments.src: 4. **Attach conditions** to must-pass legislation.
segments.tr: 4. **Bedingungen an unverzichtbare Gesetze zu knüpfen**.

segments.src: The obstacle is arithmetic.
segments.tr: Das Hindernis ist die Arithmetik.

segments.src: A president can veto a bill, and overriding a veto requires two-thirds of both chambers.
segments.tr: Ein Präsident kann ein Veto gegen einen Gesetzentwurf einlegen, und das Überstimmen eines Vetos erfordert zwei Drittel beider Kammern.

segments.src: Unless a meaningful number of Republicans join, a veto would likely stand.
segments.tr: Sofern sich nicht eine bedeutende Anzahl von Republikanern anschließt, würde ein Veto wahrscheinlich Bestand haben.

segments.src: Tariff skepticism has existed in both parties and among many business groups, so cross-party coalitions are possible, but they are not guaranteed.
segments.tr: Zollskepsis gab es in beiden Parteien und unter vielen Unternehmensgruppen, daher sind parteiübergreifende Koalitionen möglich, aber sie sind nicht garantiert.

segments.src: Courts also matter.
segments.tr: Gerichte spielen ebenfalls eine Rolle.

segments.src: Judicial rulings on how far presidential tariff authority extends can reshape the debate regardless of who controls Congress.
segments.tr: Gerichtliche Entscheidungen darüber, wie weit die präsidiale Zollvollmacht reicht, können die Debatte unabhängig davon neu gestalten, wer den Kongress kontrolliert.

segments.src: ## The budget: where the "power of the purse" becomes real
segments.tr: ## Der Haushalt: Wo die "Macht des Geldes" real wird

segments.src: Congress's strongest tool is funding.
segments.tr: Das stärkste Werkzeug des Kongresses ist die Finanzierung.

segments.src: Federal agencies operate on annual appropriations, and the fiscal year begins October 1.
segments.tr: Bundesbehörden arbeiten mit jährlichen Bewilligungen, und das Haushaltsjahr beginnt am 1. Oktober.

segments.src: A new majority gains leverage in several ways:
segments.tr: Eine neue Mehrheit gewinnt auf verschiedene Weise Hebelwirkung:

segments.src: - **Appropriations bills.** The House originates spending bills, and the Senate must also pass them. A majority in both chambers lets Democrats shape priorities, set funding levels and add policy guardrails.
segments.tr: - **Bewilligungsgesetze.** Das Repräsentantenhaus bringt Ausgabengesetze ein, und der Senat muss sie ebenfalls verabschieden. Eine Mehrheit in beiden Kammern lässt die Demokraten Prioritäten gestalten, Finanzierungsniveaus festlegen und politische Leitplanken hinzufügen.

segments.src: - **Shutdown brinkmanship.** If the two branches cannot agree, funding lapses. Shutdowns are costly and politically risky for everyone involved, which is why most fights end in compromise.
segments.tr: - **Shutdown-Pokerspiel.** Wenn sich die beiden Zweige nicht einigen können, verfällt die Finanzierung. Shutdowns sind kostspielig und für alle Beteiligten politisch riskant, weshalb die meisten Kämpfe in einem Kompromiss enden.

segments.src: - **Continuing resolutions and deadlines.** Short-term funding extensions often become the real negotiating moments.
segments.tr: - **Fortgeltungsbeschlüsse und Fristen.** Kurzfristige Finanzierungsverlängerungen werden oft zu den echten Verhandlungsmomenten.

segments.src: - **The debt limit.** Raising or suspending it is required to pay obligations already incurred, and it has repeatedly become a flashpoint.
segments.tr: - **Die Schuldenobergrenze.** Sie zu erhöhen oder auszusetzen ist erforderlich, um bereits eingegangene Verpflichtungen zu bezahlen, und sie ist wiederholt zu einem Konfliktherd geworden.

segments.src: The limits: the Senate filibuster still requires 60 votes for most legislation, unless the rules change.
segments.tr: Die Grenzen: Der Senats-Filibuster erfordert nach wie vor 60 Stimmen für die meiste Gesetzgebung, es sei denn, die Regeln ändern sich.

segments.src: Any spending bill still needs the president's signature, so a final budget would be a negotiated outcome, not a one-party wish list.
segments.tr: Jedes Ausgabengesetz benötigt nach wie vor die Unterschrift des Präsidenten, sodass ein finaler Haushalt ein ausgehandelten Ergebnis wäre, keine Wunschliste einer einzelnen Partei.

segments.src: The president can also affect how funds are spent through administrative choices, which is a frequent source of disputes.
segments.tr: Der Präsident kann auch durch administrative Entscheidungen beeinflussen, wie Gelder ausgegeben werden, was eine häufige Quelle von Streitigkeiten ist.

segments.tr: - **Ausschussführung.** Wer wichtige Gremien leitet, signalisiert, welche Themen Priorität erhalten.

segments.src: ## Bottom line
segments.tr: ## Fazit

segments.src: A change in congressional control can reshape the agenda, the budget fights and the level of scrutiny in Washington.
segments.tr: Eine Änderung der Kontrolle über den Kongress kann die Agenda, die Haushaltskämpfe und das Ausmaß der Prüfung in Washington neu gestalten.

segments.src: It is much less likely to produce rapid, sweeping changes to prices or trade policy without cooperation from the White House.
segments.tr: Es ist viel weniger wahrscheinlich, dass sie ohne Kooperation des Weißen Hauses rasche, radikale Änderungen bei Preisen oder Handelspolitik hervorbringt.

segments.src: For readers, the practical takeaway is to watch what is passed and signed into law, and not only what is debated.
segments.tr: Für Leser ist die praktische Erkenntnis, darauf zu achten, was verabschiedet und zum Gesetz erhoben wird, und nicht nur darauf, was debattiert wird.
